title: put the steps in order
seam: each step card: data-step="<key>" (its words on it); when placed, data-placed="<position from 1>"
the ONE slot the child is filling now: data-item="pos<position from 0>" (exactly one in the document; it moves as slots fill)
the cards are shown in the order of Studio.params.shown until the child places them
brief: KIND: explorable. Putting the steps of a process in order.
BOARD: the step cards in the order of Studio.params.shown (this order is NOT the answer), and a numbered track of empty slots (1, 2, 3 ...) for the ordered steps.

ACTIVITY: the child taps the card that comes next -> Studio.answer({key: <card key>}). On correct it moves into the next empty slot with its number (data-placed). On wrong it shakes gently and stays. When all are placed: the done text and Studio.done().
Every card looks the same before it is placed.
antiPatterns: the cards shown already in the right order
a card placed on a wrong tap
numbers written on the cards before they are placed
